prompts.title: Urban Eclipse
prompts.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic night portrait of a man seated confidently on a large dark stone block in a modern city skyline. He has a neatly styled, well-groomed appearance, wearing an oversized navy blue sweatshirt, gray cargo pants, white sneakers, and a black smartwatch. He sits with legs spread naturally, both hand relaxed between his legs, looking directly at the camera with a calm, confident expression. A massive detailed full moon is perfectly positioned behind his head, creating a dramatic silhouette effect. Tall illuminated skyscrapers rise on both sides in the background, deep navy blue night sky, wet reflective ground, moody urban atmosphere, cinematic lighting, realistic skin and fabric textures, dramatic low-angle composition, eye-level subject gaze, centered framing, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 8K resolution, 85mm lens, f/1.6, cinematic color grading. Aspect ratio 4:5.
prompts.description: Surreal Urban Portrait Prompt: Copy & paste this prompt to create a cinematic night photo of a young man sitting under a giant full moon in a modern cityscape.
